title: U3 · Library Work page
description: One Work from registry/works/<slug>.json (+ its releases, source_links, relationships, evidence) rendered as the eight-section module page (docs/module-page-template.md). type decides the family: research_question → U5, project → U4, private → U11. Shared $defs in templates/U0/schema.json.

heading.description: kicker = section · type · maturity; title = Work name; subtitle = reading.subtitle; badges = repo visibility, licence, releases count; status = maturity + updated_at + gls id

sections.description: keys: why map repos sauce contents agent evidence releases activity related

reasoning.description: why = reading.why (authored, labelled); source = his words if any

map.description: typed relationship map: repo, releases, related Works (relationships[]), people, questions, projects

repos.description: provenance.locators[] with visibility, revision, verified, rights (license.spdx)

sauce.description: reading.highlights[]: 3–7 real assets with a dated proof

contents.description: capabilities with state, plus the procedure

evidence.description: evidence[] as facts; provenance.license as version; limits stated

activity.description: owners.log / OWNERS.md lines for this Work's owner, dated
